scenes.head: 歡迎來到品富餐飲
scenes.say: 你好，歡迎來到品富餐飲。用九十秒，認識我們怎麼準備你的每一餐。
scenes.veo: Wide establishing shot of a bright, spotless food counter in a hospital food court at lunchtime, staff in white uniforms and hairnets smiling and serving customers.

scenes.head: 我們在你身邊
scenes.say: 品富在醫院、科技園區設櫃，服務每天忙碌的醫護人員、工程師，和每一位朋友。
scenes.veo: Montage feel: a nurse and an engineer in a cleanroom-style jacket each picking up a lunch box from a counter, friendly handover, natural daylight.

scenes.head: 好餐點的起點
scenes.say: 我們相信，一份好的餐點，從新鮮的食材開始，也從確實的流程開始。
scenes.veo: Close-up of fresh vegetables, eggs and chicken being placed on a stainless steel prep table, droplets of water, morning light.

scenes.head: 收貨把關
scenes.say: 每一批食材進到廚房，都要先檢查外觀、溫度與有效日期，合格才能入庫。
scenes.veo: A kitchen staff member with gloves checking a delivery box, using a probe thermometer on chilled meat and reading the date on the package.

scenes.head: 分區保存
scenes.say: 冷凍、冷藏、乾貨和蔬菜分區存放，各自有固定位置，避免交叉污染。
scenes.veo: Slow pan across an organized walk-in refrigerator with labeled shelves and neatly stacked containers, cool blue light.

scenes.head: 清楚標示
scenes.say: 分裝後的食材，都會貼上品保標籤，寫清楚品名、原包裝有效日、分裝日期和櫃位使用期限。
scenes.veo: Macro shot of a gloved hand sticking a small white food label onto a sealed food container on a steel counter.

scenes.head: 智慧升級中
scenes.say: 我們正在導入智慧品保標籤系統，由系統計算並列印日期，減少手寫錯誤。
scenes.veo: A staff member tapping a rugged touchscreen terminal in a kitchen, a compact thermal label printer next to it printing a label.

scenes.head: 用心烹調
scenes.say: 廚房夥伴依照標準流程烹調，讓每一份餐點的味道與份量都穩定一致。
scenes.veo: Chef stir-frying vegetables in a wok with a gentle flame, steam rising, then plating rice and side dishes into a lunch box.

scenes.head: 我們想聽你說
scenes.say: 對餐點有任何建議，歡迎告訴現場夥伴，我們會持續改進。
scenes.veo: A customer chatting warmly with a counter staff member who nods and listens attentively, soft background bokeh.

scenes.head: 品富餐飲
scenes.say: 品富餐飲，每一餐，都安心。謝謝你的光臨。
scenes.veo: Slow push-in on a beautifully plated Taiwanese bento box on a wooden table, warm golden light, steam gently rising.
